rejectedCandidates.reason: Light-on-dark variant. The company hub renders on a light ground, and the site's schema declares the primary file above as the Organization logo, so this variant is not the one to use here.

This is the site favicon, not the wordmark: a 512x512 square mark. It is also not a true vector logo — 183 KB of SVG containing two <image> elements, i.e. raster data wrapped in SVG. The brief's SVG preference applies to a genuine vector logo file, which this is not.
